title: 皐月賞の後に・我が刹那にて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After winning the Satsuki Sho in spectacular fashion, Mejiro Ardan reflects on both her hard-fought victory and how far she's come since the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the same time, however, the memory of Yaeno Muteki and Sakura Chiyono O's running refuses to fade from her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without letting the victory go to her head, Mejiro Ardan promises to continue her winning streak at the Aoba Sho and the Japanese Derby afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Mejiro Ardan's win reminds Yaeno Muteki and Sakura Chiyono O of the threat she poses for the upcoming Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Motivated by their loss at the Satsuki Sho, they each vow to seize victory at the Japanese Derby.
